meta.subject: Luxe Studio Salon
meta.about_summary: Luxe Studio Salon offers a premium hair and beauty experience with master stylists boasting over a decade of expertise. We exclusively use top-tier European products for services ranging from advanced coloring and treatments to meticulous nail and facial care, ensuring exceptional results in a welcoming, luxury environment.

creativeDirection.inspirationReference: high-end spa, fashion editorial set, soft lighting, marble surfaces, gold accents, plush chairs
